findingsResolved: dirty reads discarded drafts; replacement requires explicit confirmation and failed reads retain draft
malformed/redirected setting acknowledgements allowed confirmation reuse; block until fresh read
logout left hidden full configuration text; clear every draft and own summary
post-dispatch self redirect and untrusted errors could falsely retain credentials; classify as unknown and retire
duplicate protocol headers, contradictory existence, 202 or nonempty 2xx ACK could be trusted; require exact single headers and empty 200/204
self identity decoding accepted ambiguous aliases/duplicates; enforce exact unique typed fields
401/403 with large or stalled self response body masked authorization; map status before consuming body
S3v2 advertised unwritable conditional support; read only with no revision
raw invalid UTF8 and isolated UTF16 were silently substituted; reject before dispatch or persistence
pending rotation blocked local logout; preserve auth/Origin/CSRF and revoke only its session
in-flight login registered during rotation; recheck under session commit lock
Fiber pre-read preceded handler timeout; install targeted header-time deadline and test actual ServeConn wiring/reuse
lifecycle actions bypassed tags, duplicated selection and mutated shared slices; uniform immutable URL-decoded matching
delete-marker-only active rules were skipped; mark active while preserving prefix/disabled filtering
legacy cleanup errors permitted later writes that leftover files could overwrite; abort subsequent RMW
replication added after CAS version suspension; recheck fresh versioning in metadata transaction
noncurrent transition destination was not validated; validate legacy target and reject unsupported P3 field
retainedLimitations: P3 conditional lifecycle writes reject NoncurrentVersionTransition, including disabled rules; legacy documents remain readable
P3 conditional lifecycle writes reject Tag with ExpiredObjectDeleteMarker=true
noncurrent remote transition execution and stable persisted target selection require future work; no experimental ARN/IsLatest changes applied
reproductionNotes: Raw failed counterexamples and final targeted outputs are embedded below.
The original transport-test handler counter counted Fiber error traversal; corrected to business route counting.
The legacy missing-target negative test was corrected to native 404/XOtterioAdminRemoteTargetNotFoundError; production error semantics were preserved.
The pending-logout before-fix test observed503 instead of reaching CSRF/authenticated204 checks; final owner/other-session tests pass.
